data.title: AI 智能体 Harness 工程：仓库上下文、反馈循环与人类监督
data.summary: 学习 OpenAI Harness 工程实践中如何通过仓库上下文、反馈循环与人类监督让 Codex 智能体可靠工作。

questions.stem: 根据资料，人类工程师在该智能体优先的开发模式中，主要工作重心发生了什么变化？

options.text: 主要工作变为直接编写大部分业务代码
主要工作变为设计环境、明确意图并构建让智能体可靠工作的反馈循环
主要工作变为完全停止参与，由智能体独立决定产品优先级
主要工作变为只做代码格式检查，不再验证结果

questions.explanation: 资料指出，团队的主要工作不再是写代码，而是设计环境、明确意图并构建反馈循环，使 Codex 智能体能够可靠工作。

questions.stem: 资料提到，该仓库完全由智能体生成，因此其优化首先服务于什么？

options.text: 第三方开源社区的贡献便利性
代码压缩后的最小体积

questions.explanation: 资料明确说明，由于仓库完全由智能体生成，它首先针对 Codex 的可理解性进行优化，使智能体能直接从仓库推理完整业务领域。

questions.stem: 当智能体遇到困难时，资料建议团队如何对待这一信号？

options.text: 忽略该信号，要求智能体继续重复尝试
由人类直接手工重写全部相关代码
识别缺失的工具、护栏或文档，并让 Codex 自己编写修复并反馈进仓库
立即降低验收标准以让任务通过

questions.explanation: 资料指出，智能体遇到困难应被视为信号：找出缺失的工具、护栏或文档，并始终让 Codex 自己编写修复，反馈进仓库。

questions.stem: 根据资料，为把 Codex 的拉取请求推进到完成，团队指示它做哪些事情？

options.text: 在本地审查自己的更改
在本地和云端请求额外的特定智能体审查
回应任何人类或智能体给出的反馈
跳过所有审查，直接合并到主分支

questions.explanation: 资料描述了让 Codex 本地自审、请求本地与云端特定智能体审查、回应人类或智能体反馈，并循环迭代直到所有智能体审查者满意。

questions.stem: 根据资料，在这种智能体优先的模式中，人类始终保持在循环中，只是在与以往不同的抽象层次上工作。
questions.explanation: 资料明确写道人类始终留在循环中，但在不同的抽象层次上工作：优先排序工作、把用户反馈转化为验收标准并验证结果。

sources.excerpt:
Humans interact with the system almost entirely through prompts: an engineer describes a task, runs the agent, and allows it to open a pull request. To drive a PR to completion, we instruct Codex to review its own changes locally, request additional specific agent reviews both locally and in the cloud, respond to any human or agent given feedback, and iterate in a loop until all agent reviewers are satisfied (effectively this is a Ralph Wiggum Lo
…
We intentionally chose this constraint so we would build what was necessary to increase engineering velocity by orders of magnitude. We had weeks to ship what ended up being a million lines of code. To do that, we needed to understand what changes when a software engineering team’s primary job is no longer to write code, but to design environments, specify intent, and build feedback loops that allow Codex agents to do reliable work.
…
The first commit to an empty repository landed in late August 2025. [...] Because the repository is entirely agent-generated, it’s optimized first for _Codex’s_ _legibility_. In the same way teams aim to improve navigability of their code for new engineering hires, our human engineers’ goal was making it possible for an agent to reason about the full business domain directly from the repository itself.
…
Humans always remain in the loop, but work at a different layer of abstraction than we used to. We prioritize work, translate user feedback into acceptance criteria, and validate outcomes. When the agent struggles, we treat it as a signal: identify what is missing—tools, guardrails, documentation—and feed it back into the repository, always by having Codex itself write the fix.
